area.name: Lom-Kadéï gold belt (East Cameroon)
area.why: Artisanal and semi-mechanised gold mining along the Lom, Kadéï and Doumé rivers.

arrays.land: share of the cell that is land (Hansen data mask)
arrays.forest2000: share of the cell under tree cover >= 30 % in 2000
arrays.near_water: share of the cell within 300 m of water
arrays.loss: share of the cell whose trees were lost that year (rows = YEARS)
arrays.loss_near_water: the same, within 300 m of water
arrays.new_permanent_water: share of the cell that is « new permanent water » (GSW transitions 1984-2021)
arrays.new_seasonal_water: share of the cell that is « new seasonal water » (GSW transitions 1984-2021)
arrays.lost_permanent_water: share of the cell that is « lost permanent water » (GSW transitions 1984-2021)
arrays.lost_seasonal_water: share of the cell that is « lost seasonal water » (GSW transitions 1984-2021)
arrays.ephemeral_seasonal_water: share of the cell that is « ephemeral seasonal water » (GSW transitions 1984-2021)
arrays.population: people in the cell (WorldPop 1 km, rows = POP_YEARS)
arrays.dist_stream: distance (km) from the cell to any river or stream (OpenStreetMap)
arrays.dist_river: distance (km) from the cell to a river (OpenStreetMap)
arrays.dist_road: distance (km) from the cell to any road, track or path (OpenStreetMap)
arrays.dist_main_road: distance (km) from the cell to a trunk, primary, secondary or tertiary road (OpenStreetMap)
arrays.dist_village: distance (km) from the cell to a village, town or city (OpenStreetMap)
arrays.dist_town: distance (km) from the cell to a town or city (OpenStreetMap)
arrays.mine_mapped: share of the cell under a mine or quarry mapped on OpenStreetMap (0.001° drawing)
arrays.dist_mine: distance (km) to the nearest mine or quarry mapped on OpenStreetMap
arrays.maus_mapped: share of the cell under a Maus et al. (2022) mining polygon
arrays.dist_maus: distance (km) to the nearest Maus et al. (2022) mining polygon

sources.hansen: Global Forest Change v1.13 (Hansen et al. 2013)
sources.gsw: JRC Global Surface Water v1.4 (Pekel et al. 2016)
sources.maus: Maus et al. 2022, global mining polygons v2 (PANGAEA 942325)
